'''2009 US West Nationals Day 2 Ryan Freeman LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Freeman]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)|VB4-L-hiddenbase-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Freeman
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
